For every fixed rational $0<\delta<1$, a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from binary 3SAT produces a nonempty unweighted game of value exactly $1$ on satisfiable inputs and at most $\delta$ on unsatisfiable inputs. Each constraint projection has exactly two preimages for each output label. The alphabet depends only on $\delta$, and the runtime is measured in the original input bit length.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
